title: Coordinate subcube
statement: For a finite set $S\subseteq[n]$ and a base point $b\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, define the coordinate subcube to be the set of vectors $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ such that $x_i=b_i$ for every $i\in S$.
